the NCEP Step 1 diet is not the best diet for the majority of patients with type 2 diabetes, and the diet that we developed, which is higher in protein and lower in carbohydrates, is a better alternative.

we have shown that the NCEP diet (National Cholesterol Education Program diet) is not the most effective diet for reducing LDL cholesterol.

a diet lower in total carbohydrate, and higher in monounsaturated fat and protein, is more beneficial for the prevention and treatment of the metabolic syndrome, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular disease than the National Cholesterol Education Program Step 2 Diet.
